name: Becsvölgye (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Becsvölgye (a green and white shield with a yellow tree and green stars) above the name BECSVÖLGYE in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
